entries.title: Psalms 88:1
segments: <<A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath aLeannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.>> O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 88:2
segments: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.

entries.title: Psalms 88:3
segments: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.

entries.title: Psalms 88:4
segments: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
segments: Cast  off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.

entries.title: Psalms 88:6
segments: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
segments: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 88:8
segments: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

entries.title: Psalms 88:9
segments: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
segments: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall  they that are decreased arise and praise thee? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 88:11
segments: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in  Destruction?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
segments: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
segments: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 88:14
segments: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 88:15
segments: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

entries.title: Psalms 88:16
segments: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
segments: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.

entries.title: Psalms 88:18
segments: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance  into darkness.
